cards.concept_name: Spinal cord disorder causing neurogenic bowel
Disclose the minimum necessary information to prevent imminent serious harm
Invite a chosen family member or Elder
Offer a time-limited trial of treatment with agreed stopping criteria
Use a low-dose antipsychotic for dangerous agitation
Offer access to an Indigenous patient navigator
Usual nausea and vomiting of pregnancy
Assess decision-making capacity for the specific treatment decision
Review prior capable wishes and the advance care plan
Identify the legally appropriate substitute decision-maker
Use benzodiazepine treatment for withdrawal delirium
Obtain the patient's consent before disclosure
